description: Curated tournament-proven constructed decks for per-element specialist fine-tuning. Rushfire Gate (AZK01-122) intentionally kept legal (pre-ban lists valid). Tier A = winner/top-8 at a sanctioned or sizeable event or X-0/X-1 regional swiss; tier B = documented strong finish (top-32/top-10% of a 100+ field, top-16 of the 64-player Invitational, official top-4 archetype with self-reported list) or #1-ladder author list. heldout_eval_only decks (about 1/3 of tier-A per element, rounded) must never be trained on.

tier_rules.A: winner/top-4/top-8 at a sanctioned or sizeable event, or X-0/X-1 swiss at a regional
tier_rules.B: documented strong finish (top-32/top-10% of a 100+ field, top-16 of the 64-player invite-only Invitational, official placement with self-reported list) or #1-ladder author list
